source: Original Little Road catalogue; ported from preserved Godot checkpoint

parts.name: Race pads
parts.hint: Strong braking with matching road tyres.

parts.name: Sport pads
parts.hint: Later braking; tyre grip still limits deceleration.

parts.name: Stock pads
parts.hint: Allow plenty of braking distance.

parts.name: Light chassis
parts.hint: Better acceleration and braking from less weight.

parts.name: Stock chassis
parts.hint: The standard car's weight.

parts.name: Club motor
parts.hint: Power for longer gearing. Needs good tyres in bends.

parts.name: Stock engine
parts.hint: A modest, dependable starting motor.

parts.name: Workshop tune
parts.hint: Stronger starts and hill pulling. Gearbox still limits top speed.

parts.name: Precision rack
parts.hint: Fast response for technical bends. Smooth inputs help.

parts.name: Quick rack
parts.hint: Quicker direction changes without adding tyre grip.

parts.name: Stock rack
parts.hint: Calm but slow response.

parts.name: Close-ratio gearbox
parts.hint: Better corner exits and climbing; lower maximum speed.

parts.name: Long-ratio gearbox
parts.hint: Higher speed ceiling; slower acceleration and needs a strong motor.

parts.name: Stock gearbox
parts.hint: Balanced short gearing; can limit a stronger motor.

parts.name: Club turbo
parts.hint: Stronger high-speed acceleration. Match with tyres and long gearing.

parts.name: Naturally aspirated
parts.hint: No forced induction. Predictable stock power delivery.

parts.name: Street turbo
parts.hint: More pulling power; tyres and gearing determine how much you can use.

parts.name: Road sport tyres
parts.hint: Fast tarmac corners, but weaker on loose ground.

parts.name: Stock tyres
parts.hint: Basic road grip; poor on rough ground.

parts.name: Touring tyres
parts.hint: An affordable improvement on road and trail.

parts.name: Trail tyres
parts.hint: Secure on dirt; less road grip than touring tyres.
